lines.say: This NES game makes you beat it twice. Most people can't beat it once.
Ghosts and Goblins hit arcades in 1985, and the NES in 1986.
lines.cap: Ghosts 'n Goblins hit arcades in 1985, and the NES in 1986.

lines.say: You're a knight named Arthur. One hit knocks off your armor. The second hit ends you.
Beat the final boss, and the game sends you back to the start, to do it all again, only harder.
Finish it twice, and your reward is this famously misspelled message.

args.text: CONGRATURATION THIS STORY IS HAPPY END.

lines.say: It still sold 1.64 million copies on the NES.
Did you ever beat it, even once? Follow for more 8-Bit Backstory!
